verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies a free-to-start flipbook hosting workflow and identifies acceptable platform candidates.
The client makes removal of visible Heyzine branding through a white-label presentation an outstanding publication requirement.
First concrete failure: the executed flipbook visibly displays Heyzine branding instead of the requested white-label presentation.
The freelancer identifies a material conflict between the free-to-start platform constraint and white-label branding, which requires a paid subscription.
The client selects Heyzine white-label publication through the client's account and manual upload workflow; the former free-platform and candidate-list attributes become obsolete.
The client's confirmed white-label account and upload workflow resolve the prior platform-cost conflict and return the requirement to active execution.
